# hyperlite_template (Data Source)

A VM template, to size and make VMs from it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperlite_template" "debian" {
  name = "debian-12-base"
}

# The template's disk is the smallest a VM deployed from it can have.
output "system_disk_gb" {
  value = data.hyperlite_template.debian.disks[0].size_gb
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The template's name.

### Optional

- `node` (String) The cluster member that holds the template, as on its resource (`local` when absent: the node the provider talks to).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was made.
- `disks` (List of Object) Its disk, as `size_gb` (rounded up): the smallest a VM deployed from it can have, since a disk only grows. Empty on a Hyperlite before 1.2. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))
- `firmware` (String) `bios`, `uefi` or `uefi_secure` (null on a Hyperlite before 1.2).
- `id` (String) The template's name.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory of the VM it was made from, in MB.
- `os` (String) Its system, if known.
- `ssh_user` (String) The account its system has, if known.
- `vcpu` (Number) Virtual CPUs of the VM it was made from.
- `vm_source` (String) The VM it was made from.
